detail.longDescription:
A professor just let me know about my (random) barcode generator being broken and causing issues for his students.

They were using my generator for "Analogs of stellar absorption spectral lines for astronomy" Whatever that means.

It was a caching error in the end though. I forgot to nuke Cloudflare after a recent deploy. But it does amaze me how people can use things in ways you never expected.

#webdev
